t: SikaMix mortar plasticiser (dark brown) is a liquid admixture designed for enhancing mortar and plaster mixes. Improves the overall quality and handling of materials, making it ideal for professional bricklayers and plasterers on various construction projects. The plasticiser increases workability, durability, and cohesion of bricklaying mortars, renders, and screeds. The chloride-free formula helps prevent steel corrosion, cracking, shrinkage, and efflorescence without affecting setting time. Supplied in a robust 5Ltr jerry can.
